symptom: Audio clock interrupted. Playback paused; press Play to resume.
rootCause: A forward audio-clock gap over 100 ms cancelled pending silent warm-up even though the score driver had not begun playback.
fix: Reset the startup stability window after a clock gap; only fail for a forward clock gap when the score driver is playing.

cases: Clock gap during silent warm-up preserves Play and starts the first note once after 250 ms of stability
Deliberate Play tolerates a gap since the last idle quantum
An interruption after playback begins still pauses with no automatic restart or catch-up
Stop cancels pending startup after a gap

validation.manualChrome: Existing user tab reloaded after deployment; saved Toy Ensemble started on one Play press, advanced without the notice and was left paused in Performance with Fireflies and Slow rotate restored.
validation.limits: No acoustic or physical-device qualification. Actual clock interruptions during active playback remain guarded.
